target_claim: By construction, X can be ordered as x1, x2, . . . , x|X| in the order they were deleted, and at the time xj was deleted it had fewer than t neighbors remaining. In particular, in the induced subgraph on {x1, . . . , xj-1} it has degree at most t - 1.
